findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the state of a request: pending until your user confirms the email, then confirmed (Protoship answers by email)." → after: "Returns the state of a request: pending (waits for your user to confirm the email), confirmed (on its way to Protoship), forward_failed (confirmed, sent again within the hour), forwarded (Protoship has it and answers by email within two working days), answered, closed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
